_comment: SEED ONLY. Layer 1's rocks now live in the app's own store (Netlify Blobs), edited from the dashboard under 'Manage rocks', with an audit trail of every change. This file is used for exactly two things: it seeds the store the first time it is read if the store has never been written, and it is the fallback if the store cannot be reached, so a storage outage degrades Layer 1 to this rather than emptying it. Editing this file does NOT change a store that has already been written. Rocks are data and change weekly; the RULES that judge them (tolerance window, capacity, cross layer thresholds) stay in config/leadership.json and still change by pull request.
